dataset.hash_recipe: SHA256 of row-major little-endian float64 data bytes, then raw uint8 target bytes, then UTF-8 json.dumps(feature_names, separators=(',', ':'))

partition.row_id_definition: zero-based row index in the pinned scikit-learn dataset

preprocessing.shared_fit_on: training rows only, once for all four classifiers
preprocessing.test_action: transform only; record coordinates clipped to the training-fitted angle range

quantum.sampled_kernel: compute-uncompute circuit; frequency of the all-zero measured word
quantum.training_diagonal: analytic one; no diagonal sampling circuits
quantum.training_symmetry: estimate each unordered off-diagonal pair once and mirror the same value
quantum.duplicate_policy: measure every declared non-diagonal and test-training pair even if its transformed inputs coincide
quantum.circuit_order: training upper triangle in row-major order, then test rows by training columns in row-major order

spectral_repair.fit_on: training Gram matrix only; never test labels or a test-test Gram matrix

classifiers.test_input_reuse: both inference calls consume the already prepared angle features or precomputed cross-kernel; no new quantum evaluation
classifiers.convergence_warning_action: fail the row; retain evidence; do not substitute a different model

cases: self overlap must produce 256 all-zero shots
distinct-input overlap checked against statevector fidelity
calibration.failure_action: stop before matrix sampling; record calibration_failed

metrics.paired_quantum_difference: quantum_shot balanced accuracy minus quantum_ideal balanced accuracy on the same sixteen records
kernel_diagnostics: raw training relative Frobenius error against ideal
raw test-training relative Frobenius error against ideal

execution.full_sampling_launch_gate: calibration and measured timing must pass; obtain separate launch approval with command, runtime estimate and resource cost
required_recording: per-record labels predictions and decision scores
execution.admission_rule: complete counts for every declared pair, input hashes unchanged, finite arrays, valid calibration and all four classifier rows before a completed comparison

scope_limits: matched inputs and preprocessing, not matched model capacity
synthetic ideal measurement noise, not a hardware-noise model
no novelty, speedup or quantum-advantage claim
